content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue while programming the [product_name] display module. I set up an asynchronous generator to alternate between two message texts. Occasionally, there is a brief flicker when switching to the other message instead of a smooth transition, although sometimes it works correctly. I considered whether another display might be starting simultaneously and then turning off, but couldn't confirm this. I've uploaded a video showing the issue. Does anyone have suggestions on what might be causing this? Thanks in advance for your help!
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Could you please upload your project as a zip file for review?
Thank you for the quick reply. I'll upload the file.
Is this your entire project? It seems that there are several blocks with incomplete output connections, which prevents me from transferring the program to a [product_name] controller.

This is the full program in ladder format. In my version, there aren't any incomplete blocks. If you run a simulation and activate I10, you should see the issue I'm describing. I created it using [product_name] programming software (trial version).

It's possible that this flicker effect only happens in the simulation environment. To test it on a physical [product_name] device, all blocks need to be properly connected; otherwise, the program shouldn't be transferred. While this isn't necessary during simulation, proper wiring is required for real hardware.
Please refer to the attached screenshots.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members discussed a visual issue on the [product_name] display module, where intermittent flickering occurs during message transitions. The problem's cause was not identified, but suggestions revolved around simulation limitations and ensuring the program is fully wired for actual device testing.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects seamless message transitions on their [product_name] display, without flickering or irregular visual artifacts.
